model: The page background used an SVG feTurbulence filter. A filter with 3 octaves is evaluated across the painted viewport. A 1920x1080 frame is 2,073,600 pixels. The replacement is one 64x64 tile, 4,096 pixels, decoded once and repeated. 2073600/4096 = 506.25.

noise.rule: The pixel counts are exact. This does not time a browser paint sample.
